forbidden_patterns: Do not modify build.gradle.kts without explicit request
Do not change AndroidManifest permissions without confirmation
Do not change Room entity schema without migration plan
Do not modify NtfyService configuration (critical for notifications)
golden_patterns: Use StateFlow for UI state in ViewModels
Use sealed classes for UI events and results
Keep composables small and focused (single responsibility)
Use dependency injection via Hilt for all repositories and use cases
Follow MVVM: UI observes state, ViewModel processes, UseCase executes business logic
Naming: ViewModel suffix, UseCase suffix, Screen suffix for composables
Use Result<T> wrapper for operation outcomes
